name: Arboleaf
notes: Arboleaf body-composition scales use the Qingniu (QN-Scale) Bluetooth protocol. 8-electrode dual-frequency models send each limb and the trunk at 20 and 100 kHz plus the scale's own results; 4-electrode models send weight and one or two whole-body impedances. Close the Arboleaf app (or turn off its auto-sync) while weighing in over Bluetooth: the scale talks to one phone app at a time.

field_notes.muscle_mass_kg: Arboleaf's "Muscle Mass" is soft lean mass (fat-free mass less bone), not skeletal muscle.
field_notes.smm_kg: Skeletal muscle % of body weight, as a mass.
field_notes.fat_free_mass_kg: Lean body mass % of body weight, as a mass (fat-free mass: it and body fat add up to the weight).
